description: This file defines the AttendanceService class, which manages attendance records, configurations, and permissions within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations on attendance data, configuration of user roles and permissions, and integration with workflow state management.

classes.name: AttendanceService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee attendance records, configurations, and permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of AccessFlowStateMachineService instance.

methods.name: getAttendanceDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of AttendanceDao instance.

methods.name: setAttendanceDao
methods.description: Sets the AttendanceDao instance.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Checks if current user is permitted to change current time settings.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Saves an attendance punch record.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records for an employee.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for an employee on a specific date.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes an attendance record by ID.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Retrieves an attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone string corresponding to a given index.

methods.name: getTimezoneArray
methods.description: Returns an array of timezone offsets.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone string based on client timezone offset.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks overlapping punch-in records during editing.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks overlapping punch-out records during editing.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks overlapping punch-in/out records during editing.

methods.name: searchAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Searches attendance records based on provided filters.

methods.name: getLatestPunchInRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the latest punch-in record for an employee with a specific state.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsBetweenTwoDays
methods.description: Fetches attendance records between two dates for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for a list of employee numbers within optional date range.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if user can change current time configuration based on saved settings.

methods.name: getPunchTimeUserConfiguration
methods.description: Determines if the user is allowed to modify punch time based on configuration.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Enables user permission to change current time configuration.

methods.name: disableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Disables user permission to change current time configuration.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Enables user permission to modify attendance configuration.

methods.name: disableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Disables user permission to modify attendance configuration.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Allows supervisor role to modify attendance configuration.

methods.name: disableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Revokes supervisor role permission to modify attendance configuration.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves a workflow state machine configuration record.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheEditActions
methods.description: Checks whether the authenticated user is permitted to perform edit actions on a specific attendance record.
